data.name: METAL QUADRIGA
data.detailed_description:
Pilot the revolutionary weapon that changed modern warfare—the QUADRIGA—and eliminate all threats before time runs out.

  • High-Speed Mech Action — QUADRIGA Unleashed

Blaze across the battlefield at breakneck speed in this high-intensity mech action game.
Each unit is equipped with its own unique arsenal—master their strengths and wipe out your enemies in style.

It’s not just about firepower.
Call in devastating airstrikes as time passes to turn the tide of battle in an instant.

With a lock-on focused combat system, high-speed boost dodges, and dynamic combat alerts, QUADRIGA delivers a refined and exhilarating mech combat experience.

  • You Are Expendable — Rise Again and Again

You are a cloned soldier, deployed as part of an experimental military program.
No matter how many times you are shot down, you will return to the battlefield.

But there’s a limit.

The cloning system can only operate for a short time. Complete your mission objectives before time runs out—or be lost with it.

  • Unlock Units. Find Your Perfect Machine.

Progress through story missions and training to unlock a wide range of unique units.
Fight, adapt, and discover the machine that truly fits your playstyle.

  • Enter the Colosseum

Take your customized unit into the “Colosseum” and challenge players from around the world.
Dominate the arena—and claim the title of FULL METAL QUADRIGA.
